demo_showcase.hero_title: The Intelligent CRM Built for Growth.
demo_showcase.hero_sub: From discovering prospects to closing deals, automating workflows, and retaining customers — your entire customer lifecycle, automated and connected.
demo_showcase.journey_title: One customer. Fifteen automated steps. Zero manual work.
demo_showcase.impact_title: Results your team will feel immediately.
demo_showcase.impact_sub: SERP HAWK CRM replaces your spreadsheets, email threads, reminder notes and disconnected tools with a single, automated system that works around the clock.
demo_showcase.cta_title: Ready to see it in action?
demo_showcase.cta_sub: The SERP HAWK CRM is live and ready for your team. Login to experience the full platform — or book a personal demo on WhatsApp.
demo_showcase.section_1_sub: Every lead from every source — website forms, manual entry, or Radar Analysis — enters a structured, automated qualification pipeline. No spreadsheets. No missed opportunities.
demo_showcase.section_2_title: Sales Pipeline — Every Deal. Every Stage. In Motion.
demo_showcase.section_2_sub: A visual kanban pipeline that tracks deals from first contact to closed won. Stage changes trigger automatic actions — tasks, notifications, invoices — without manual work.
demo_showcase.section_3_title: Radar Analysis — Find Your Next Client Before They Find You.
demo_showcase.section_3_sub: Discover high-potential prospects by location, market size, team size, or services. The CRM maps your target area, identifies top businesses, and adds them to your pipeline in one click.
demo_showcase.section_4_title: AI Email Agent — Personalized Outreach at Scale.
demo_showcase.section_4_sub: The AI agent studies each lead's profile, conversation history, and stage — then drafts a precise, personalized email in seconds. Your team reviews. The CRM sends, tracks, and follows up.
demo_showcase.section_5_title: Automation Engine — Your CRM Works While You Sleep.
demo_showcase.section_5_sub: Define once. Run forever. Trigger-based workflows execute automatically across your entire operation — from assigning new leads to onboarding won customers — without a single manual step.
demo_showcase.section_6_title: Communication Hub — Every Message. One Timeline.
demo_showcase.section_6_sub: Email, WhatsApp, and internal notes — all unified in a single chronological thread per client. Every conversation is automatically recorded, tagged, and made visible to your entire team.
demo_showcase.section_7_title: Analytics — Real Intelligence. Not Just Numbers.
demo_showcase.section_7_sub: Live dashboards that show lead growth, conversion rates, pipeline velocity, team performance, and revenue — updated in real time. Data-driven decisions for every level of your business.
demo_showcase.section_8_sub: Every client record connects deals, messages, tasks, documents, invoices, and support cases in a single view. Anyone on your team can pick up any client conversation — immediately, completely.

my_files.subtitle: Documents & files shared with your team.
my_files.guide_desc: Upload, organize, and share documents with your team securely.
my_files.guide_s1: Click "Add File" to upload documents, images, PDFs, or any file up to the size limit.
my_files.guide_s2: Add a description when uploading so your team knows what each file is for.
my_files.guide_s3: Download any file by clicking the download button on the file card.
my_files.guide_s4: Remove files you no longer need using the delete action.
my_files.empty: No files uploaded yet. Click Add File to share a document.

my_queue.title: My Queue
my_queue.subtitle: Manage your assigned tasks
my_queue.guide_desc_client: Here you can see all tasks related to your projects and services.
my_queue.guide_desc_staff: A Kanban-style board to manage tasks across all clients and projects.
my_queue.guide_cs1: Tasks are organized by status: To Do, In Progress, and Done.
my_queue.guide_cs2: Each task shows its priority level (Low, Medium, High, Urgent) with color coding.
my_queue.guide_cs3: Check due dates and descriptions to stay on top of deadlines.
my_queue.guide_cs4: Your team updates task progress as work moves forward on your services.
my_queue.guide_s1: Click "New Task" to create a task and assign it to a client, project, or team member.
my_queue.guide_s2: Tasks are grouped by status columns: To Do, In Progress, and Done.
my_queue.guide_s3: Set priorities (Low, Medium, High, Urgent) to keep the team focused on what matters.
my_queue.guide_s4: Use the task menu to edit details, reassign, or delete tasks.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.subtitle: All your alerts, updates, and reminders.
notifications.guide_desc: Stay informed with real-time alerts about proposals, invoices, tasks, and team activity.
notifications.guide_s1: Notifications appear here whenever something important happens — new proposals, invoice updates, etc.
notifications.guide_s2: Color-coded badges indicate type: info (blue), success (green), warning (amber), error (red).
notifications.guide_s3: Click "Mark all read" to clear the unread count, or click individual items to read them.
notifications.guide_s4: Some notifications have links — click them to jump directly to the relevant page.

teams.guide_s1: View members grouped by Sales and Development teams.
teams.guide_s2: Add new team members and assign them roles instantly.

rankings.subtitle_client: Track your keyword positions and search visibility.
rankings.subtitle_staff: Track keyword positions and monitor SEO performance.
rankings.guide_desc_client: Track how your keywords rank across search engines over time.
rankings.guide_desc_staff: Log and monitor keyword positions across clients and search engines.
rankings.guide_cs1: Each row shows a keyword, its current position, and which search engine it was tracked on.
rankings.guide_cs2: Green badges (positions 1–3) mean your keyword is ranking excellently.
rankings.guide_cs3: Amber badges (positions 4–20) mean there's room for improvement.
rankings.guide_cs4: Rankings are updated regularly by your SEO team to reflect current performance.
rankings.guide_s1: Click "Log Ranking" to record a keyword position for a client and search engine.
rankings.guide_s2: The stats bar shows total keywords, top 3, top 10, and average position.
rankings.guide_s3: Use the search and filter options to find specific keywords or clients.
rankings.guide_s4: Position badges are color-coded: green (1–3), blue (4–10), amber (11–20), red (20+).

projects.subtitle: Create, track, and manage all your team initiatives.
projects.guide_desc: Create, organize, and track team initiatives from start to finish.
projects.guide_s1: Click "New Project" to create an initiative with a name, description, and status.
projects.guide_s2: Click any project card to assign team members, set progress, and manage details.
projects.guide_s3: Each project card shows its current status (Planning, Active, Completed) and progress.
projects.guide_s4: Inside each project you can add comments, track activity, and monitor timelines.

project_detail.guide_title: How the Project Detail page works
project_detail.guide_desc: Everything about this project in one place — team, progress, comments, and activity.
project_detail.guide_s1: The header shows the project name, status badge, and creation date.
project_detail.guide_s2: Assign team members (employees and interns) from the dropdowns to manage who works on this.
project_detail.guide_s3: Add comments to discuss progress, share updates, or leave notes for the team.
project_detail.guide_s4: Update project status (Planning, Active, Completed) using the buttons and track progress percentage.
